title: Сполучники: although, however, despite
titleEn: Linking words: although, however, despite, because, so, in case
explanation:
**+ речення** (підмет + дієслово): *although, even though, because, so, in case*
**+ іменник / -ing:** *despite, in spite of, because of*
**Нове речення + кома:** *However, … · Therefore, …*
**but / so** — посередині, після коми: *It was late, **so** we left.*

Після *in case* — теперішній час: *in case it **rains***.

guide.idea: Сполучники показують, як пов'язані думки: протиставлення, причина, наслідок чи запобіжний захід. Без них мова звучить як список окремих фраз, з ними — як зв'язна розповідь.

use.note: although / even though + речення; but — посередині.
use.en: Although it was late, we stayed for one more coffee.
use.uk: Хоча було пізно, ми лишилися ще на одну каву.

use.note: despite / in spite of + іменник або -ing.
use.en: Despite the rain, the match went ahead.

use.note: However, — на початку нового речення, з комою.
use.en: The hotel was lovely. However, the food was terrible.
use.uk: Готель був чудовий. Проте їжа була жахлива.

use.en: We stayed in because of the storm.

use.note: so — у розмові, therefore — в офіційному тексті.
use.en: The shop was closed, so we went home.
use.uk: Магазин був зачинений, тож ми пішли додому.

use.note: in case — роблю зараз, бо щось може статися.
use.en: Take some cash in case they don't accept cards.
use.uk: Візьми готівку — раптом там не приймають картки.

a.en: I'll take an umbrella in case it rains.
a.note: Беру в будь-якому разі, про всяк випадок.

b.en: I'll take a taxi if it rains.
b.note: Візьму, лише якщо дощ справді піде.

a.en: We were late because the traffic was bad.

b.en: We were late because of the traffic.

a.en: Although it was cold, we went out.

b.en: It was cold. However, we went out.
b.note: Два окремі речення; however — на початку другого.

mistakes.wrong: Despite it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.right: Although it was raining, we went out.
mistakes.why: Після despite не буває підмета з дієсловом — лише іменник або -ing.

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
mistakes.right: Despite the rain, we went out.
mistakes.why: despite — без of; of буває лише в in spite of.

mistakes.wrong: We were late because the traffic.
mistakes.right: We were late because of the traffic.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was expensive, but we bought it.
mistakes.right: Although it was expensive, we bought it.
mistakes.why: Українське «хоча…, але…» англійською — лише одне з двох слів.

mistakes.wrong: Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
mistakes.right: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
mistakes.why: Після in case — теперішній час, а не will.

formula: although + S + V · despite + noun / V-ing
because + S + V · because of + noun

examples.en: Although the hotel in Chernivtsi was cheap, it was very clean.
examples.uk: Хоча готель у Чернівцях був дешевий, він був дуже чистий.

examples.en: Despite the traffic, we arrived in Dnipro on time.
examples.uk: Попри затори, ми приїхали до Дніпра вчасно.

examples.en: I'd love to come. However, I have to work that day.
examples.uk: Я б із радістю прийшов. Однак того дня мені треба працювати.

examples.en: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
I'll take some snacks in case we get hungry in the Carpathians.
examples.uk: Візьму перекус на випадок, якщо зголодніємо в Карпатах.

exercises.prompt: ___ the rain, we had a great time.
___ it was late, we kept talking.
The shop was closed ___ the holiday.
exercises.explanation: because of + іменник (the holiday); because — перед реченням.
However з комою починає нове речення; although і despite не стоять окремо.

exercises.prompt: Write down my number ___ you get lost.
Despite ___ (feel) ill, she went to work.
It was raining, ___ we stayed in. (1 слово)

exercises.sentence: Although the bad weather, the trip was fun.
exercises.explanation: Перед іменником — despite / in spite of.

exercises.sentence: We went out despite it was cold.

exercises.prompt: Хоча я втомився, я пішов на тренування.
answer: Although I was tired, I went to the gym.
Although I was tired, I went to training.
I went to the gym although I was tired.

exercises.prompt: Although it was expensive, we bought it.
answer: Despite the price, we bought it.
Despite it being expensive, we bought it.
Despite the high price, we bought it.
Despite its price, we bought it.
Despite the fact that it was expensive, we bought it.
In spite of the price, we bought it.
exercises.explanation: Despite + іменник, -ing або the fact that + речення.

exercises.uk: Візьми куртку на випадок, якщо похолодає.
answer: Take a jacket in case it gets cold.
Take your jacket in case it gets cold.
Take a jacket in case it gets colder.
exercises.explanation: in case — «на випадок, якщо» + Present Simple.
